qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Adhesive formulation know-how (Bostik) and high-performance polymers (Pebax, Rilsan) face ongoing commoditization from Chinese producers in fluorochemicals and acrylics. 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~7-8%, failing the 12% threshold (ROCE dropped to 7.8% in 2024).
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Despite strategic portfolio transformation toward specialty materials and adhesives (Bostik), Arkema remains exposed to cyclical commodity chemical headwinds, Chinese capacity additions in fluorochemicals/acrylics, and European industrial demand weakness. Multi-year after-tax GAAP ROIC of ~7-8% fails the 12% superinvestor hurdle.
qualitative.evidence: Recurring ROCE dropped from 15.5% at peak 2022 to 8.7% in 2023 and 7.8% in 2024, indicating after-tax GAAP ROIC well below 7%. Specialty operations lack the pricing power to offset severe upstream raw material inflation and Asian competition during cyclical downturns.
